# disk-usage-mcp

FastMCP server for disk usage analysis, duplicate detection, and multi-drive visualization.

## Quick links

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt) - Full documentation
- [README.md](./README.md) - Setup and usage
- [Source](https://github.com/sandraschi/disk-usage-mcp)

## Tools

- **scan_path** - Scan a drive with dua-cli, return JSON hierarchy
- **find_large_files** - Find files above size threshold
- **get_drive_overview** - Aggregate across multiple drives
- **find_duplicates** - Find duplicates with czkawka_cli
- **disk_usage** - Portmanteau: scan / tree / drive_overview
- **parse_dj_database** - Parse VirtualDJ / Serato DJ library database
- **server_help** - List tools and REST endpoints
